access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-14 (T-3553) from the museum's open-access image and object record: a black silk mourning hat by Crocker: a brimless toque of ruched silk, its folds drawn round the crown. A real garment, American, not of Chicago and not of anyone drawn in the town.
note: One of the T-3553 finery references (docs/RESEARCH/finery-3553/README.md): the toque.

what_it_does_not_supply: how any Prairie Avenue woman dressed, or the colour of any dress she owned
how often such a dress was worn on a Chicago street in 1904
